finding.question: Did the New York Post officially endorse Donald Trump for re-election as president in the 2020 U.S. election?
finding.summary: Yes. On October 26, 2020, the New York Post published an editorial explicitly endorsing President Donald Trump for re-election. The Atlanta Journal-Constitution independently reported the endorsement that day.

report_raw.claim: The New York post Endorsed Donald trumps bid for re-election.
report_raw.justification: The New York Post published an editorial on October 26, 2020, explicitly endorsing Donald Trump for re-election. [S1] The Atlanta Journal-Constitution independently reported that the Post’s editorial staff favored Trump. [S2] Inference: The endorsement establishes the claim under the stated assumption that it refers to the 2020 presidential campaign.
key_points: The Post’s own editorial explicitly endorsed Trump for re-election. [S1]
An independent newspaper reported the editorial staff’s support for Trump. [S2]
report_raw.counter_argument: A case for withholding a verdict is that the independent report’s supplied excerpt says the Post favored Trump but does not itself use the word “endorsement.” [S2] That does not prevail because the Post’s own editorial explicitly states the endorsement. [S1]
